composition_probe.question: Did RUP create new preconditions for an already-certified R33 rule that were absent before RUP?
composition_probe.phase_A: Apply frozen r33.simplify to the exact RUP-stalled residual and record measure/rule counts only.
composition_probe.phase_B: If phase_A changes the formula and remains nonterminal, run the frozen R34 complete-affine recognizer only.
composition_probe.phase_C: If phase_A changes the formula, run one diagnostic frozen R35B pass on the changed residual and record only whether progress reappears; do not iterate the cycle in R37.
composition_probe.scientific_boundary: Any positive phase is evidence that operator composition matters. R37 may not promote or iterate a restart policy; that requires a separate preregistered R37B.
